fixed.failing_test_before: packages/runtime/test/budget-pause.test.ts 'l4-money-pause, run L4: a reply cut off at its length limit has its line and the file-writing note (L4-money-106)'. The composed case runs through the runner and the executor: list_dir, then a reply cut with no blocks that uses its whole max_tokens, then a report. It failed before: GET /sessions/:id/events had no cut line, and the request said 'Answer again, more briefly'. The unit case asserts the three line forms and both note forms exactly.
fixed.how: loop.ts emits a typed `reply_cut` RunEvent (maxTokens, where, kept, the call's costUsdMicro, retry) on every cut: kept calls, a retry, and the last cut before the run errors. The executor's onEvent makes it one note line (budget-pause.ts replyCutWords): 'The coder's reply was cut off at its length limit, so nothing of it could be used (CHF 0.01); it was asked again.' With kept calls: '... (CHF x): the call it was writing did not run, and it was asked to make it again.' At the last try: '... again, so nothing of it could be used (CHF x).' cutOffNote has a `writesFiles` parameter: a run with a file-writing tool that is cut before it said anything hears 'Send less in one reply: one file per call, short enough to fit.' The warning no longer names a cap. runtime.md and user-guide.md are updated.
fixed.check_in_the_app: Live (L3-research-2's shape): a writer or researcher task asked for one long file under a small task budget (CHF 0.08). When a reply is cut at its output limit, tick Details on the session page. A line 'The <specialist>'s reply was cut off at its length limit, so nothing of it could be used (CHF x); it was asked again.' appears after the folder or file line, with the call's cost. In the model-call log, the next request's last user message contains 'Your last reply was cut off at the output limit (N tokens) before it said anything, and nothing of it was used. Send less in one reply: one file per call, short enough to fit.'. The stand-in cannot play a cut reply (its max_tokens mode is not built), so this needs the real model.

The bench stand-in cannot play a cut reply, because the messages-api.ts max_tokens mode is not built. The L4-money-106 line can be seen only in the composed test or with the real model.

When one note names no task, it is given to every task in the session, so the log has 'Gave 1 note to "A".' and then 'Gave 1 note to "B".' for the same note (bench journey f). This is true but repetitive; a later words area may fold it into one line.
notes_for_other_areas: New RunEvent `reply_cut` { maxTokens, where, kept, costUsdMicro, retry } (agent/loop.ts). It is emitted on every cut reply. The executor maps it to a task.step note through budget-pause.ts `replyCutWords(specialist, { kept, costUsdMicro, retry }, chfOf)`. The bare `warning` stays for logs, but it no longer names the next call's cap.

`cutOffNote(maxOut, where, kept, writesFiles = false)`: a file-writing run cut before it said anything gets the 'one file per call' wording. It is model-facing text, asserted exactly in budget-pause.test.ts.

session.planned now carries `promised` (number) when a session.promised event follows. views.ts then words the Plan line without a count or figure ('Plan: <summary>.'). StaticPlanner's first-session summary is 'the first session you approved with the project plan, in its order' (no count). task.notes reads 'Gave N note(s) to "X".'

budgetLineWords' outer forms (project/month) changed words: '..., the rest of the project's budget[ after CHF y for its review]: it is told to wrap up before a step that could pass CHF z, keeping CHF w to finish.' The task-budget and plain forms are unchanged. l4-chat-answers (merging after this area) touched none of these files.
